'''Riva Rosetta'''<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[Resistance technician|technician]] in the [[Resistance navy|fleet]] of the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. She wore [[Color|brown]] overalls with a brown [[belt]], black [[boot]]s and orange [[Armor|helmet]]<ref name="TLJ" /> including an insulated ground crew [[headset]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> Rosetta had fair skin and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Riva Rosetta first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
